# A spurt throws a blob of magma (oMagma, 200 hit points: 372), which lands and forms a Magma Man with them
# (408), and it loses 1 a step. The player drops a bomb (391), and it walks into him and burns him (472).
# The bomb goes off on 510 and kills him. The Magma Man is down to 99, and the explosion makes two blobs of
# oMagma's fresh 200, which form two Magma Men with 200 each (560). On 561 one of them sets off and melts
# back into a blob (its 1 in 6), which keeps its hit points: 199.
